grid._comment: The film's grid: one steady tempo for the whole film. The music is scored to this grid, not measured from a finished track. List finished music under 'music' ({ file, at, until, fadeOut }) and the preview mixes it in. After any change run: node video/tools/resolve.mjs

shots.screen: The text box appears alone in the center on the first beat, cursor blinking on the beat.
shots.fx: Near silence: one soft pulse per beat.

shots.say: Make a 3d racing game where humanoids fight while racing...
shots.screen: Words land in the box as they are spoken. A 'Game' chip slides out under the box.
shots.fx: Chip pops on the shot's second downbeat.

shots.screen: The Game chip splits in two: 'Unity' on beat 1, 'Roblox' on beat 3.
shots.fx: A small impact under 'Roblox'.

shots.screen: 'Trailer' chip.

shots.say: also Make an ad campaign tailored to Unity and Roblox players
shots.screen: 'Campaign' chip with three mini chips (Explainer, Reel, Image).
shots.fx: The music starts building here: every chip from now on adds a layer.

shots.screen: 'Host' chip with a globe tick.

shots.say: oh, and at the end Show the process on a video.
shots.screen: 'Recorder' chip with a red record dot that starts blinking and keeps blinking for the rest of the film.
A thin 'Verifier' ring closes around every chip. Beat of silence. Enter key press exactly on the next downbeat.
shots.fx: Line spoken in the first bar. The ring closes over the second bar as the build peaks; its last beat is silent. The second bar is also the spare room for a slower read.

shots.screen: DROP. The box collapses into a thin bar at the top and becomes the root cell. First ring fans out: Game, Trailer, Campaign, Voice, Host, Recorder, Verifier.
shots.fx: White flash + shake on beat 1. One cell lands per beat.

shots.screen: Game cell opens as a sub-orchestrator: Design, then a Unity orchestrator and a Roblox orchestrator, each sprouting its own subtree (Track, Karts, Combat, Humanoids, UI, Build).
shots.camera: Push into the Game cell; the subtree fills the frame.
shots.fx: Edges draw with travelling light.

shots.screen: Unity > Karts cell. Step ticker advances, editor viewport frames stream in (kart on track), a code diff glints past.
shots.camera: Zoom into the cell until it is the screen.
shots.fx: Step ticks on 8th notes.

shots.screen: Roblox > Combat cell. Studio viewport frames: humanoids swinging at each other from karts.
shots.camera: Whip-pan across the graph from the Unity subtree to the Roblox subtree.
shots.fx: Motion blur on the pan.

shots.screen: Asset handoff. The Unity orchestrator emits a request ('kart + driver models'); a bright edge shoots across the graph to the Assets cell. Inside it: concept image, cutout, mesh, rig, one thumbnail per beat.
shots.camera: Follow the request along the edge.
shots.fx: The request fires on the first downbeat. Thumbnails pop on beats 1-4 of the second bar.

shots.screen: The asset packet travels back and lands in both engines: the same model appears in the Unity viewport and the Roblox viewport.
shots.camera: Pull back to a split stage.
shots.fx: Both viewports flash on arrival.

shots.screen: Trailer cell. Gameplay strip, beat grid, cuts snapping onto beats; one second of the finished trailer plays in the stage.
shots.fx: Cut markers snap in time with the music.

shots.screen: Campaign cell and its subtree: Explainer reel, Premise reel, Ad image. The Voice cell draws the cloned-voice waveform. Three vertical reel frames stand up side by side.
Host cell. Browser build bar fills, a tunnel line connects to a globe, the public URL types out, a browser frame loads the game.
shots.fx: The URL lands on beat 3.

shots.screen: Recorder cell shows the graph being recorded (picture in picture, one level of recursion). Then the Verifier: check marks cascade across every cell.
shots.fx: The music thins out; one check per 16th note.

shots.screen: Whole tree is green. Two game windows rise out of the graph: the browser build and the Roblox game, both running.
shots.camera: Wide, windows scale up from their cells.

shots.screen: Full-bleed split gameplay: humanoids fighting while racing, Unity left, Roblox right.
shots.fx: Hard cuts on every beat inside each half.

shots.screen: Roblox premise ad (vertical) with the game behind it. Flips from day to night on the second downbeat. A 'Lighting' cell flashes in the mini-graph.
shots.fx: Line in the first bar. Day-to-night as a single-frame match cut.

shots.screen: Roblox and Unity windows side by side. A Roblox racer appears in the Unity window and a Unity racer in the Roblox window. 'Relay' cell flashes.
shots.fx: Line in the first bar. A line links the two windows on the second downbeat.

shots.screen: Unity window wipes left to right into the upgraded look: post-processing, reflections, lighting. 'Shaders' cell flashes.
shots.camera: Slow push on the Unity window.
shots.fx: Line in the first bar. The wipe starts on the second downbeat and lasts exactly 2 beats.

shots.screen: 'Music' cell flashes. The chosen song plays for two bars (about 4 seconds) with its waveform across the bottom while gameplay continues.
shots.fx: Line in the first bar. The score ducks under the song clip, then slams back.

shots.screen: Deliverables wall assembles instantly: Play-in-browser link, Roblox link, trailer (2 s), three reels (1 s each), ad image.
shots.fx: The music resolves. One tile per half beat.

shots.screen: Fake ending. The wall dims, a small wordmark fades up, the music resolves and tails into silence.
shots.fx: Fade toward black. A real final chord: the beat stops and only its tail rings on.

shots.screen: The wordmark glitches and rewinds. The text box slams back to center.
shots.fx: Author's 1.5 s sound effect over a rewind riser. The music returns harder on the next downbeat.

shots.screen: Generated house image resolves full-bleed.
Same house, same framing, walls red.
shots.fx: Match cut on the downbeat.

shots.screen: Background drops away; the dimmed graph shows through behind the house.
Floor plan drawing: walls, doors and dimensions draw line by line.
shots.fx: Lines draw to the hi-hat.

shots.screen: Blender viewport screenshots: the house rising from the plan.
shots.fx: One build step per beat.

shots.screen: Realistic render resolves from noise.
The render comes alive as a short clip.

shots.say: Check all presentations on Canvas and make a study guide for every... single... test.
shots.screen: Course decks fan out. On 'every', 'single', 'test': one guide, a row of guides, a wall of guides.
shots.camera: Pull back one step on each of the three words.
shots.fx: Sentence over the first two bars. Hits on 'every' (third bar, beat 1), 'single' (third bar, beat 3) and 'test' (fourth downbeat).

shots.say: CAD a drum shooter FRC robot prototype.
shots.screen: SurfaceCAD assembly builds piece by piece: frame, drum, flywheel, hood.
shots.fx: One part per beat in the second bar.

shots.screen: The robot shooting inside the FRC simulator.

shots.say: Make a [board to be decided] PCB.
shots.screen: Board layout: traces route themselves, then the board flips to a 3D view.
History line draws, then the forecast and its band extend to the right.
Same chart: red markers snap onto the outliers.
shots.fx: Markers on beats.

shots.say: Put the car on the house.
shots.screen: The kart from the game lands on the roof of the house in Blender.
shots.fx: Impact on the second bar's downbeat.

shots.say: Put the house on the game.
shots.screen: The house, kart still on its roof, stands beside the Unity track as racers fight past it.
shots.camera: Hold, then begin a very slow zoom out.

shots.screen: Slow zoom out. The graph now holds every cell from the film. Evidence fades. Prompts swipe through the text box, one per beat.
shots.fx: Full energy. The rhythm doubles with the prompts in each of the next two shots.

shots.screen: Prompts every half beat. Title word above: 'everything...'
shots.fx: The rhythm doubles.

shots.screen: Prompts every quarter beat, blurring. Title: 'and anything...'
shots.fx: The rhythm doubles again, then cuts to silence on the last beat.

shots.screen: Every cell implodes into the wordmark: Infinite Harness.
shots.fx: One final impact on the downbeat.

shots.screen: 'Built with AI' under the wordmark. Fade to black.
shots.fx: The impact's tail rings out and ends.
